<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserCreatedData
{
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $zeta,
        public int $alpha,
        public bool $mid,
        public ?float $beta,
        public ?array $omega,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            zeta: $data['zeta'],
            alpha: $data['alpha'],
            mid: $data['mid'],
            beta: $data['beta'],
            omega: $data['omega'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'zeta' => $this->zeta,
            'alpha' => $this->alpha,
            'mid' => $this->mid,
            'beta' => $this->beta,
            'omega' => $this->omega,
        ];
    }
}
